verdict.rationale: Extend documents a dedicated Splitting capability that uses split classifications, identifier keys and split rules, alongside a Classification product. Splitting is a first-class endpoint across the API (sync and async), the CLI and the homepage messaging ('parse, extract, and split'), and Workflows give a plausible path from a single upload to per-document processing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that one packet upload chains split, classify and per-document extraction results; any detail on output format per split document; independent or hands-on corroboration of split accuracy.
